content:
Use Story Studio Canvas with Seedance 2.5 to pre-organize characters, scenes, and story flow before generating to maintain visual consistency across an entire project  
Generate cinematic long takes up to 30 seconds in Seedance 2.5 instead of stitching short clips to keep characters and scenes consistent through a complete sequence  
Direct the scene with micro-level timestamp control by specifying exact actions at specific times (e.g., 0:00 grapple toward tunnel; 0:03 swing past train; 0:07 front tracking shot; 0:10 controlled landing; 0:13 hero pose)  
Create a 30-second RPG character showcase by keeping the same character design, camera language, and visual style from start to end using Story Studio + Seedance 2.5  
Turn a simple product shot into a premium ad by prompting for cinematic lighting, macro product shots, elegant transitions, and luxury CGI commercial visuals using the same Story Studio + Seedance 2.5 workflow
